Delete the side and front views of a girl in nude

Delete the close shot(s) of indecorous movements of the dancer on 'cep'

Reduce the fight in the drinking den, by deleting the hard hitting and gruesome visuals

Delete the word Dhaka wherever it occurs in the song and also the vulgar and indecent movements of Mona during the song (Replacement of the word dhaka wherever it occurs in the song by the word Alse together with the shots approved)
